title: Shinonome Akito — A Choice To Be Proud Of〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: A Choice To Be Proud Of（2★）

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Akito, welcome.
The usual?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Toya isn't here yet.
Huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ken, where's An at?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, she's out getting some stuff for me. She should be back soon.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Here's your usual blend...
Want some extra sugar with that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, I'm good.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, I heard that you helped An with something.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not sure how much it helped, but I just asked her if anything was going on with her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I guessed that something was and...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Toya and I were surprised, but she really had it the worst from what I could tell.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've experienced that before too, so I knew how she felt then.)

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: The BAD DOGS, huh? Akito's new partner's got some real talent, don't you think...?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Yeah, he does. Akito can probably just leave the singing to him and lip sync everything else.

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Hahaha! Why isn't he doing that already?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: I know, right? Kind of a “use or lose it” situation, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Having an incredible partner is something anyone can be proud of...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But being that person's partner and keeping it that way isn't easy.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you still worried about An?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? No, I was just thinking about something that happened a long time ago...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
A long time ago...?
Oh, that's right. You did go through quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But you showed all those naysayers what you were made of and made it this far.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Seeing my customers' opinions about you changing over time has been pretty fun to watch.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess I just hate losing.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Haha. I can tell.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, this might end up being a good experience for An.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...? You think so? I mean, she seemed pretty depressed from what I saw.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: She'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yes, she's my daughter and I love her, but she's yet to experience any sort of real loss or failure...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Of course, she hasn't.
She has more talent than anyone my age.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Right. And her first major challenge came in the form of finding the “right partner”.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Oh, there's also that time you guys performed in STAY GOLDEN and didn't do as well as you were hoping.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But that's it. Those are the only times she fell short.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: There may be other things that I just don't know about or she hasn't told me...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: But compared to you and Toya, she's had to deal with far less. You've been climbing a big hill while she's been on flat ground.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: However, she still wants to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Plus, Arata's returned at the perfect time, so she may yet be faced with another significant challenge.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Although, she didn't end up being the one to take the bait...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ugh...! I'm not losing next time...!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Hahaha!

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Still, to think that her partner causing a stir would coincide with STAY GOLDEN both times.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: In hindsight, An made a good decision in terms of choosing a partner.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And she's not done yet...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Right. They're both good singers in their own right, but their partnership is still in its infancy...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If something like this does happen again, I hope you and Toya will be there to help them out.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We will.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's what being a team's all about.
